module: Security guard for the v1/runRepro schema command: decides whether a decoded command line may be passed to run_repro.bat, based on an allowlist of glob patterns. The pure logic (isAllowed) is separated from reading the allowlist file (loadPatterns).
notes: The allowlist is read from /DevTools/tests/micropy/resources/repro_allowlist.json, field permissions.allow (array of patterns). If the file is missing or invalid, the list is empty so everything is refused (fail closed).
The characters < > ^ ` " and control characters (including CR/LF) are forbidden everywhere in the command.
The command is split on && || ; | & ; each segment must match at least one pattern. In a pattern, '*' stands for any sequence of characters; other characters are literal.
Only leading spaces of a segment are removed; the trailing space stays in the segment.

isAllowed.desc: Pure function: tests whether command satisfies the pattern list. Refuses an empty command, one with a forbidden character, an empty list, or one with a segment matching no pattern.

returns.desc: 'ok' or the reason for the refusal (empty command, forbidden shell metacharacter, empty allowlist, no command segments, segment not allowed: ...).

loadPatterns.desc: Reads the allowed patterns from the allowlist JSON file. Logs an error and returns {} if the file is missing or malformed.

isCommandAllowed.desc: Shortcut: loads the patterns from disk then calls isAllowed.
